state.description: Upgrade the 477 ACSR portions of the Urquhart – Toolebeck 115 kV line to 1272 ACSR. Replace existing structures with Single Pole Double Circuit Structures. Approximately 12.5 miles.

q.instructions: Is this OpenStreetMap substation the endpoint the filing names?
